title: Social Security (Administration) Amendment (Income Management Reform) Bill 2023
short_title: Social Security (Administration) Amendment (Income Management Reform) Bill 2023

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would continue the government's reform of income management for welfare recipients by moving people to an improved system.
It would extend the enhanced income management regime to include all measures from the existing Part 3B regime, give people a choice to switch, and direct new entrants to the enhanced system.
The changes would start on a single date set by proclamation or six months after Royal Assent, whichever comes first.
changes: Extends the enhanced income management regime to include all measures from the Part 3B regime.
Gives people subject to the Part 3B regime the choice to move to enhanced income management from the commencement date.
Directs all new entrants to the enhanced income management regime.
summary.affected: Welfare recipients eligible for income management, particularly those in the Part 3B regime and new entrants.

In the absence of having these sorts of measures, how on earth can the government measure the success or otherwise of their decisions?
